Count the digit sums block by block.

- Numbers 1 to 99: the units and tens digits each run through 0–9 ten times, so the sum is 2 · 45 · 10 = 900.
- Numbers 100a to 100a+99, for hundreds digit a: the hundreds digit contributes 100a, and the last two digits contribute 900. The block sum is 900 + 100a.

Cumulative sums:

| Up to | Cumulative digit sum |
|---|---|
| 99 | 900 |
| 199 | 900 + 1000 = 1900 |
| 299 | 1900 + 1100 = 3000 |
| 399 | 3000 + 1200 = 4200 |
| 499 | 4200 + 1300 = 5500 |
| 599 | 5500 + 1400 = 6900 |
| 699 | 6900 + 1500 = 8400 |
| 799 | 8400 + 1600 = 10000 |

The total reaches exactly 10,000 at n = 799. Each added number has a positive digit sum, so no other n gives this total.

ANSWER: 799
